<thought>The spectrum shows a strong M peak at 193, with a +1 peak at ~12.5 % of M and a +2 peak at ~1.1 % of M, matching the natural 1.1 % abundance of ¹³C and the expected binomial envelope for a molecule containing many carbons. No characteristic halogen (Cl, Br) or sulfur (34S) patterns are present, and the minor isotopes of N, O, H are too low to be observed. Therefore, carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified from the isotope distribution.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
